proposition: Two warm letters from Ibn Turka to Qāsim-i Anvār (nos. 37 and 38) are the only direct evidence of their relationship; one was written after several days in his company, probably in Herat, in 830/1427 or 834/1431 (MK), and calls Qāsim naqīb.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka to Qāsim-i Anvār, letters 37-38
mediation.note: letters within the block MK reads as exile-period network building
